description: Conrad Paulson lives a secret double life as master thief Redmond. There is nothing he can't steal, nothing he can't have... except for the life he left behind. Now, with a grown son he hardly knows, and an ex-wife he never stopped loving, Conrad must try to piece together what's left of his life, before the FBI finally catch up to him... but it appears they are the least of his worries.

As Augustus tries his best to save his kidnapped girlfriend from the cartel, Agent Cohen begins to lean in on him for a lead on Redmond. You'll never guess who he turns to for help with his current situation. Hint: it's not his father.
The lines are drawn between the cartel and Augustus' group in the race to save Emma. The only problem is that things could get a little grisly before either party is ready to strike.

Can Augustus prove to his father that he?s built for a life of crime? Or will Conrad?s worst fears about his son be confirmed as their plan to double-cross the cartel falls apart around them? And who is the familiar foe back on Conrad?s case?

Conrad and Augustus are trapped with nowhere to run from the cartel and FBI. Can father and son's first heist together end in any way but death or capture? Find out in the conclusion to THIEF OF THIEVES' second arc!

Heist master Andy Diggle joins the THIEF OF THIEVES team for the start of a brand new arc! Meet Lola, the Cartel boss. And what Lola wants, Lola gets - and Conrad's going to learn that the hard way. Get ready for the most EXPLOSIVE story arc of THIEF OF THIEVES yet!
It's go time for Conrad's Italian heist!
A sit down with the Godfather...
Caravaggio. Picasso. Van Gogh. It's time for these legends to get acquainted with a real master: Redmond. But is even he daring enough to steal from the Mafia?
The Godfather is not pleased. Will Conrad make a clean getaway, or double down for the biggest score of his career?
Special Agent Cohen has plagued Conrad’s every step. Until now… The end of ANDY DIGGLE’s THIEF OF THIEVES arc ends with a real BANG.

Conrad Paulson has turned his back to his life as Redmond, international master criminal, in order to regain some semblance of the life he left behind. Will it be enough to reconcile with his wife? Save his son from the life? Or will it end up getting them all killed?
"THE HIT LIST" starts here! Conrad may have pulled off his last heist, but not without making some new enemies. Is anyone in his life safe?
The first casualties on a new crime war mount up. Plus, learn just why they call him “Lola”...
THE HIT LIST continues as Conrad chooses sides in the Cartel/Mob war...and makes a dangerous new ally.
When shots are fired in the Cartel/Mob war, will Conrad steal something he never has before—a human life?
As "The Kill List" marches towards its conclusion, somebody's got to die…
Down Mexico way, it's kill or be killed...and a major player doesn't make it out alive in the conclusion to "The Hit List."
How does the world’s greatest thief relax? Even on vacation, Redmond is always working…
There's a new thief of thieves running things…
What has Cohen been up to since being dismissed from the FBI? Harboring a few grudges with a certain thief…
One thief’s career is over while another’s just getting started.

Conrad's son, Augustus, has done everything he can to live up to his father's legacy. The simple fact is he just isn't that good a thief. His bungling has left him exposed, but will Agent Cohen be able to trace Augustus back to his father, finally catching Conrad red-handed?
Redmond’s day in court arrives. Who will pay for his crimes?
This issue sets the stage for the next phase of the master criminal’s legendary career.

NEW STORY ARC

Conrad has been the undisputed thief of thieves throughout the world… until now. Who are his rivals? Does he have what it takes to outfox them in his most thrilling heist yet?

“GOLD RUSH,” Part Two

Three thieves with reputations that precede them, two Russian billionaires, and one impossible heist—what can go wrong?

“GOLD RUSH,” Part Three

The world’s three greatest thieves beg, borrow, and steal to infiltrate London’s Shard skyscraper in the first leg of their heist—where reputation has no value, and honor is disposable.

“GOLD RUSH” Part 4 of 6.

The race is on—literally! Conrad and Celia speed through London in a stolen car against master thieves Fausto Delgado and Sally Pike. Will Conrad cross the finish line only to find that he’s no longer on top?

“GOLD RUSH,” Part Five

Never steal from Russians. Never.

END OF STORY ARC: “GOLD RUSH,” Part Six

The inevitable betrayal, an unexpected reward, and the moon landing of crime: the race to crown the greatest thief in the world crosses the finish line!

NEW STORY ARC!

THIEF OF THIEVES returns to kick off its final job! Conrad Paulson is dead—or is he? And what does a notorious Russian prison have to do with the master thief known as Redmond?
Conrad Paulson… lives? But he’s stuck in prison. In Russia. In the dead of winter. Surely, it’ll be a piece of cake to break him out, right?
Augustus' past comes to full light as the hunt for Redmond rages further. Will the mistakes of his son jeopardize Conrad Paulson's greatest caper?
Almost dying won’t stop Conrad from plotting against the Russians who destroyed his life. But will Celia risk losing him so soon after coming back from the dead?
Conrad and Celia are going to hit the Zubovs where it hurts. But will a familiar face return to ruin everything?
How do you take down the richest people on Earth? By blowing up everything they own. The Zubovs messed with the wrong thief.
For the past six years, Conrad Paulson has done the impossible. Now, can the man who was once the greatest thief in the world pull off one final heist—and walk away scot-free?
Conrad Paulson - AKA Redmond - is making final moves for his pending heist, and the FBI may have enough on his past to be one step ahead.
The heist you've been waiting months to see goes down! Will Redmond - AKA Conrad Paulson - be able to pull this off, or will his final caper leave him behind bars, or worse... six feet under?
The conclusion of the first story arc of this hit new series! Unfortunately for Redmond, despite all his efforts to the contrary... nothing goes as planned.

Redmond's big heist did not turn out as planned... and the aftermath shows that every action has an equal - and equally violent - reaction. Generation Hope writer JAMES ASMUS kicks off an all-new story arc!
Augustus' troubled past comes back to bite him where it hurts - and Redmond's son has to step up to the plate to keep an angry cartel at bay. Meanwhile: Cohen pushes harder on Conrad.

Scully and Mulder's investigation of a bizarre death in a Brooklyn church threatens to uncover an incredible plot involving an "inner government" conspiracy, the Vatican, an unscrupulous antiquities dealer, and the object of the clandestine search--the parchment containing the stolen last Fatima prophecy that seems to have an astonishing way of destroying anyone who attempts to read its secret.

issue_title: Feelings Of Unreality Part 1: Wheels Within Wheels
description: Mulder finds clues that lead him to believe a number of their recent cases are interconnected. Now, a government mole seems intent on leading him to further answers. What neither he nor Scully knows is that a mysterious force seems to be manipulating the strings that are leading both of them around.

issue_title: Feelings Of Unreality Part 2: The Ancient of Days
description: As Scully and Mulder follow the trail of the Ilbal, Scullys investigation leads her to assist in an experiment to help understand hallucinations. Mulder meanwhile follows the trail of a strangely invulnerable thief. This leads to him becoming the subject of an experiment himself. Hes just a lot less willing subject than Scully.

issue_title: Feelings Of Unreality Part 3: Nightmare Of History
description: Mulder and Scully are confronted by Skinner, asking where they have been for the past three weeks. Problem is, they thought they were right there the whole time. Realizing their memories have been tampered with, they track down a woman who was subjected to government memory experiments and who was part of the last case they have records of working on. Can they recover their memories and figure out how it all fits together?
A gifted computer game programmer murders the other members of his project team and claims to have been controlled by an experimental computer program.
Mulder rushes to the woods to look for a crashed UFO, only to have a group of children mistake him for an alien.

issue_title: Home Of The Brave - Part 1 of 2
description: A supersonic UFO in Georgia brings Scully and Mulder there. Mulder is injured as they are ambushed by a group of survivalists. These people have been terrorized by the object and intend to take the FBI agents to find it. Until it finds them instead.

issue_title: Home Of The Brave Part 2 of 2: Who Will Die First?
description: Pinned down in a house by a seeming UFO, Mulder and Scully must rely on the help of the Vietnamese mail order bride of one of the survivalists to escape. When the UFO catches up with them the woman must make a decision that may decide the FBI agents fate.

In 1945 a fleet of planes vanished in the Bermuda Triangle. Fifty years later one of the pilots seems to have returned, telling stories about being abducted by a UFO. Now its up to Scully and Mulder to prove the whole thing is just a hoax. Assuming of course that it is.

Mulder and Scully are called in when a group of scientists investigating the phenomenon of ball lightening disappear. While they investigate, another duo examining the groups data are attacked by a strange force. Arriving at the scene, the FBI agents are investigating when the strange energy comes searching for them as well.

The strange atmospheric phenomenon in North Carolina continues to frustrate Scully and Mulder. They do have a plan though. Mulder theorizes that it might actually be a living being with thoughts and feelings. Now they just have to come up with a way to capture it. All the while frustrating those people that just want to kill it.

Scully and Mulder discover that the alleged crash site of an extraterrestrial craft could be at the center of a government-sanctioned web of lies and violence as witnesses to the long-ago event are murdered when they start recalling the truth of what happened.

issue_title: Family Portrait - Part Two: The Camera Eye
description:
Henry Franklin, a Black Hills tourist photographer, has suffered a mysterious death, and his corpse was found in an advanced state of mummification. When FBI Special Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully begin their investigation, they discover the possibility that Franklin is somehow linked to a series of mysterious maladies that struck people who had their photographs taken by him. And that some people who had him take their pictures had disappeared!

As the investigation continues, Fox Mulder finds himself becoming inexplicably fascinated with Franklin's old portrait camera. Somehow, the facts they need to solve the mystery involve that camera. The question is, will the camera help the agents solve the mystery, or make them victims?

Someone, or something is killing students at a Hawaii university. Mulder has some thoughts about a choking ghost but Scully has other suspects. When they find out the full story behind the killings, will it clear everything up? Or make it even cloudier?

Have you signed your organ donor card? If you havent, how would you feel if your spouse decided to donate your organs after you died? Hopefully not like the man Mulder and Scully are chasing. He seems intent on retrieving his organs from their recipients.

A man disfigured in a car accident finds a coat with a special lining. It can drain the life from others and use it to repair his damaged face. Can Scully and Mulder find him and stop him before his transformation is complete and he disappears?

A group of Boy Scouts set out on a survival adventure. When one of the Scout Masters goes off the deep end the boys run off, but only some of them escape. Mulder and Scully show up to take the case. When Scully asks why he is interested, Mulder says the Scout Master sounds like he is suffering from the Windigo Syndrome, something that has seemed to be turning men into monsters in the area for years. They find even more evidence when they track down the Scout Master.
Is the missing Scout Master more or maybe less than he seems? Scully and Mulder track down the other half of the Scout troop and run head long into the missing Scout Master and a grizzly bear.

Someone is killing psychics. A group called remote viewers, those able to see details of a far away place if given the co-ordinates, were used by the CIA for a while. There were twelve when the project was shut down. All of the psychics went into private practice, but now someone has killed ten of them. Clues point to the CIA as the ones responsible. A high ranking source tells Mulder its because they believe one of them has turned traitor.

Scully and Mulder use their own remote viewer to track down the rouge psychic. Their task just became a lot more urgent when the people the psychic is working for steal some weapons from the US Army. It becomes much more of an X-File when it becomes known their real target is a crashed UFO in US custody.

Kidnapped by foreign agents, Mulder seems doomed. That is until a shadowy figure who has been following him the entire case decides he needs Mulder alive. He also offers Mulder the answers he has been seeking most of his adult life. But the price he asks may be more than Mulder is willing to pay.

A rouge FBI agent plays upon Mulder's emotions by offering to reunite him with his long lost sister in exchange for access codes to the Pentagon's computers.

Special Numbered Edition - see pic below.

An Anti-Government militia compound in Oregon has been under siege for six weeks. All of a sudden the militiamen ask for Mulder and Scully by name. When they get there, the FBI agents find the compound has been infiltrated. By what, they dont know, but it has stripped the flesh from one of the men in the compound.

Scully and Mulder must figure out what is killing people in the militia compound. Even if the do, and manage to contain or destroy it, can they prevent the scientist responsible from escaping with his research?

An elderly man claims tiny green goblins are terrorizing him and his wife. Mulder and Scully investigate and find……something. When further evidence reveals that the man may be abusing his wife, the complexion of the entire investigation changes.

Six women have died from what appears to be spontaneous human combustion. All are sixty-two years old, widowed, and recent immigrants from India. Sounds like an X-File. Shortly after Scully and Mulder begin investigating, a seventh woman survives what seems to be an attack from a cloud of smoke. She relates an amazing story. Back in India she was a member of a cult that expected women to burn themselves alive if their husbands died. Just before she came to America her husband passed away, but she did not follow the dictate. Now her husbands ghost appears to have come to find out why.

Variant photo cover - see pic below.

Workers at project HAARP, testing the effects of bouncing high frequency waves off of the ionosphere, are being killed by flocks of ravens. Mulder thinks it is Mother Nature fighting back. Scully has a more mundane explanation. They had better find out who is correct before they are the next victims.

A mobster is almost killed in a gunfight. When he wakes up, ghosts seem to have followed him back and want to kill him. Scully and Mulder are trying to find the truth, but when Scully finds out she has a personal connection to the case, will it impair her judgement?

Scully tries to keep here personal feelings out of the case as she and Mulder convince their charge to testify against the mob. Now they just have to make sure he lives to get there. Maybe they can get some help from those elusive spirits.

When Mulder and Scully investigate a killing supposedly perpetrated by a "Goatman", they find themselves confronted with a species trying to stave off extinction.

This issue has no title in the comic, but was supposed to be called: The Face of Extinction.

When dolphins in marine parks begin killing their trainers, Mulder and Scully are called in. They find all of the dolphins involved were originally part of a military operation in Vietnam. Now it appears someone is controlling the dolphins, causing them to revert to their earlier training.

A man dies while having a shower. His body is eaten away down to the skeleton. Scully and Mulder have a sample of what seems to be the culprit. Is it really true that this corrosive killer is really just a mutated strain of a 1960s childrens toy?

Scientists investigating the site of the 1908 Tunguska crash experience weird effects. Witnessing this is one of the survivors of the original incident way back when. A few months later the skeleton of one of the scientists shows up in Nevada with varying amounts of Carbon-14 sucked from different parts of the body. This leads Mulder and Scully to a strange building in the desert, the old man who survived the original crash, and an even stranger creature.

A man is found drowned a half mile away from the nearest body of water, while one of the ambulance drivers who transported the body shows signs of being exposed to radiation. This leads Mulder and Scully to a government cover-up involving decommissioned nuclear warheads.

A string of murders seems to be attributable to werewolves. When a couple of the killers end up dead, from silver bullets no less, Scully and Mulder need to track down this killer of killers. Even though it appears he may be a werewolf himself.

Last issue.

Art cover artist: Miran Kim

The Tunguska creature begins siphoning radiation as it builds towards critical mass. Sacrificing himself so that Scully can escape with Khobka, Mulder is captured at the secret military base and taken before a council of shadowy government figures.

issue_title: Firebird Part Three: A Brief Authority
description: As the military tries feverishly to destroy the alien creature, Mulder and Scully believe they have found the solution. Now they must reunite Khobka with his amulet and get him to the creature before it destroys the entire state of Nevada.

A murderer kills by drilling a hole in his victims foreheads. Mulder believes it is being done because the killer wants his victims to experience a kind of psychological awakening. A series of notes left for them bring Mulder, Scully and Agent Drake closer and closer to their quarry. Will they realize just how close the killer is before its too late?

A group of radicals believe there is an ancient Aztek city in the mountains of Alaska. When two of their number go missing while looking for the city, the group do something… radical, which attracts the attention of the FBI. Fallout from this leads to Mulder and Scully undertaking a search for the missing duo. They manage to find one of them, though he is not quite himself anymore. He then leads them to something even stranger.

issue_title: Silent Cities Of The Mind Part 2
description: Scully and Mulder discover an ancient artifact that may be the key to communicating with the gods. Too bad the military is determined to take it away from them. And leave no witnesses.

His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned -- and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death...or vengeance.

Created by Kenturo Miura, Berserk is manga mayhem to the extreme -- violent, horrifying, and mercilessly funny -- and the wellspring for the internationally popular anime series. Not for the squeamish or the easily offended, Berserk asks for no quarter -- and offers none!

But job one is to find a way to free Griffith, the Hawks' leader, from the dank dungeons and 'round-the-clock tortures of the Hawks' former benefactor, the King of Midland. But while the flayed and starved Griffith may be in isolation, he is not alone. Horrors beyond imagination await Guts and the Hawks in the catacombs, and those who die may just be the lucky ones!

Starved, tortured mercilessly, and imprisoned in an iron mask, Griffith hangs on to life and sanity by a thread... and he'll be no help against the King's latest charges sent to bring him back to pay for his dalliance with the King's daughter.

Now the depleted Hawks will have to face the Knights of the Black Dog, led by the merciless, bestial Wyald... one bad dog who's even worse when he unleashes the beast within!

The Band of the Hawks' rescue of their leader, Griffith, has brought them no ease. Broken beyond healing, a frail ghost of his former glory, Griffith is now more an object of pity than a man, and the Hawks, who've grimly hung together under duress and death during his absence, are now on the verge of splintering to the winds. But Griffith's dreams and ambitions, built on the bodies of his troops and the countless enemies they have slain, have not gone unnoticed in the spirit realm, and though Griffith has nowhere to go as a man, he may yet have a future... A future borne on jet-black wings in the company of the demon lords of the Godhand!

The Band of the Hawk may have been the most formidable band of fighters around, but when matched up against an army of abyssal monstrosities, earthly fighting skills don't amount to a hill of beans. The Hawks' tortured and mutilated former leader, Griffith, has used the accursed Crimson Behelit to open the gates to a shadowy realm of unspeakable horrors, the realm of the demon lords of the Godhand, who are willing to transform Griffith into a being of terrible power and majesty as long as Griffith is willing to give up his former command as sacrifices in the Invocation of Doom. But nobody takes down the Hawks without a fight, and their berserker champion, Guts, will take on anything Hell can throw at him in order to save his lover, Casca, from the sordid violations that only Hell can offer.

The once unbeatable Band of the Hawk is smashed, and their former leader, Griffith, has made an unholy pact with the demon lords of the Godhand, sacrificing his former troops to resurrect his crippled body and ascend to stand in power beside these profane gods. The Invocation of Doom has unleashed a plague of unspeakable horrors upon the earth, and the first battle not only shatters the Hawks, but the hand of their champion, Guts, and the mind of their captain and Guts' lover, Casca. And while time may heal some of Guts' wounds, it will not heal his desire for vengeance. And his discovery of a gigantic, dragon-slaying sword might be just the ticket to deal out some king-sized payback! Now cursed with the Brand of Sacrifice - a sigil that will forever mark him as prey for the damned - and with his companions dead, his lover's mind destroyed, and his one-time commander and friend reborn as a malevolent demon lord, it seems that more than ever Guts must rely upon his instinct to survive. But Hell has many faces, and when what appears to be an innocent country village proves to be a den of tragic secrets, the horror of a fairy tale perverted by pain and hate may prove to be more than Guts can handle!

On the death of Midland's king comes invasion, demonic forces seem to be on the rise, underground pagan cults are running wild, and the church is busily rounding up and teaching heretics the errors of their ways. While Guts is busy testing out his newly repaired sword on the invaders, his former captain and lover, Casca, her mind wrecked by her unholy tryst with the demon lord, has fallen in with a rough crowd who don't exactly wish her well. But she, like Guts, is marked with the Brand of Sacrifice, and her abusers may soon find themselves face-to-face with the unholy abominations that are inexorably drawn to the Brand!

But the Holy Iron Chain Knights' campaign to rid the kingdom of heretics by any means necessary puts Casca in mortal danger, and Guts is having none of it. The evil Count uses his dark powers to transform a defeated guard captain into an inhuman horror to combat Guts, the Black Swordsman. Puck, Guts' pint-sized fairy sidekick, is captured when he attempts to stop an old doctor's execution, and he is given as a gift to the count's daughter, a sweet girl in a gilded cage, imprisoned by her father in her own room.

Guts, determined to make mincemeat of the Count, assaults the castle and carves a swath of blood-soaked destruction through the Count's minions. Face-to-face with the Black Swordsman at last, the Count reveals his true form, and even Guts' super-sized sword may not be big enough to contend with this demonic monstrosity!

There waits the fanatic torturer of the Holy See, Mozgus, who plans to treat the rumored witch to the proper agonies of the damned. Guts is on his way to rescue Casca and dish out some chastisement of his own on any who get in his way, but forces in the demonic realms are in motion and are being drawn to the torture tower. It may all be a prelude to a second Eclipse and an unprecedented release of malign spirits into the world!

Mozgus, the malefic master Inquisitor of the Holy See, in his murderous campaign against heretics has captured Guts' former lover Casca and has her at the ready to be burned at the stake in the Tower of Conviction - little knowing that Casca's demonic Mark of Sacrifice is drawing hideous dark powers to the Tower. It'll take everything Guts has and more to defeat Mozgus - who is much, much more than a man - and even if he can, will be be able to save Casca from the hordes of Hell amidst the Inquisitor's disintegrating citadel?
